arStrings.szText: You've acquired the ability to steal {c_highlight}Boss Powers{/c}! Equip your powers in the {icon:Inventory_Tab_Icon_Boss_Selected, 2.} {c_highlight}Boss Powers Tab{/c} of your {c_highlight}Inventory{/c}.
New {icon:Inventory_Tab_Icon_Boss_Selected, 2.} {c_highlight}Boss Powers{/c} are acquired from the first-time kill of targeted {c_highlight}Bosses{/c} across Sanctuary.

Each Boss Power has two sides to its effects, {icon:BossPower_B_Icon, 2.3} {c:FFDB4F0E}Main{/c} and {icon:BossPower_A_Icon, 2.3} {c:FF7a9d0f}Modifier{/c}, activated based on the {c_highlight}Power Socket{/c} they are equipped onto.
Equip a Boss Power on the {icon:BossPower_B_Icon, 2.3} {c:FFDB4F0E}Main Power Socket{/c} to obtain a devastating power of the Boss it was acquired from.
Equip up to 3 Boss Powers in the {icon:BossPower_A_Icon, 2.3} {c:FF7a9d0f}Modifier Power Socket{/c} to further amplify your total power capabilities.

Battle {icon:Marker_ApparitionIncursionSigil, 2.3} {c_highlight}Apparition Incursions{/c} and {icon:Marker_Dungeon_BossLair,1.8}{c_highlight}Lair Bosses{/c} to earn {icon:Item_BossPower_Currency, 2.3} {c_highlight}Spectral Ash{/c} to upgrade acquired powers.
